references.text: Gibeon is mentioned as one of the cities in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin in the allocation of the land
Geba is mentioned as a city in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin
Parallel text listing the same Levitical cities from the tribe of Benjamin, including Gibeon and Geba
Geba is mentioned as a city in Benjamin during the reign of King Asa
Gibeon is introduced as an important city whose inhabitants made a covenant with Israel
Geba is mentioned in the prophecy about the Assyrian king's advance toward Jerusalem
Geba is mentioned in connection with Jonathan and his armor-bearer's heroic act
